question: A invests ₹8,000 and B invests ₹11,000 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 3 years, B gets ₹720 more interest than A, then find the rate of simple interest per annum.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in principal between B and A = ₹11,000 − ₹8,000 = ₹3,000.

Extra simple interest generated by this additional ₹3,000 in 3 years = ₹720.

Extra simple interest for 1 year = ₹720 ÷ 3 = ₹240.

Rate of interest = (Interest for 1 year ÷ Extra Principal) × 100

Rate = (240 ÷ 3000) × 100 = 8%.

**∴ The correct answer is 8%.**
